THESE PETITIONS HAVING BEEN HEARD AND RESERVED ON 24.03.2023, COMING ON FOR PRONOUNCEMENT OF ORDER THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 5 CRL.P NO.103902/2022  C/W CRL.P NO.100291/2022  ORDER 1.
These two criminal petitions are filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. to quash the criminal proceedings initiated in Crime Nos.179/2021 and 181/2021 of Harugeri police station.

2. Since these two petitions are arising out of common facts and the petitioner in Crl.P.No.100291/2022 and petitioner No.1 in Crl.P.No.103902/2022 is one and the same person and as such they are clubbed together and decided by common order.
3. In Criminal Petition No.100291/2022 petitioner is the lone accused where as in Criminal Petition No.103902/2022 petitioners are arraigned as accused Nos.1 to 6.
Therefore for the sake of convenience, they are referred to as accused Nos.1 to 6.

In Criminal Petition No.100291/2022,
accused No.1 has contended that he and respondent No.2/complainant are residents of Koligudda village of Raibag taluk Belagavi district and their houses are nearby.
They became friends over the social media during the year 2020.
Later on their friendship developed into love affair.
Ultimately as consenting adults, they had sexual relationship with each other.
In fact accused No.1 had intention to marry her.
In the meanwhile he was appointed as Reserve Sub Inspector and he had to undergo training at Kalaburgi.

Since his parents were not in favour of accused No.1 marrying the respondent No.2, he requested her to wait till the training period is over so that they can marry with the blessings of their parents.

sentences.text: However respondent No.2 chose to file a criminal complaint.

After registration of the complaint,
accused No.1 married respondent No.2 on 01.11.2021 at Aranyasiddeshwar temple without the blessings of their parents but in the presence of some of his cousins and friends.
Their marriage is also registered with the Registrar of Marriage, Raibag.

After the marriage though accused No.1 took respondent No.2 to his house by convincing his parents, she stayed there only for a week and started harassing the accused No.1 demanding to deposit Rs.30 lakhs in her name in a fixed deposit and also to transfer one acre of agricultural land standing in the name of father of accused No.1 in her name for her future security.
Respondent No.2 used to abuse the mother of the accused No.1 and in fact the mother of the accused No.1 tried to commit suicide on account of the attitude of respondent No.2.
5. Having regard to the fact that accused No.1 and respondent No.2 are two consenting adults and subsequent marriage, their physical relationship does not amount to rape.
The allegations made out in the complaint are false, frivolous and prays to allow the petition.

sentences.text: Accused Nos.1 to 6 were fed up with the attitude of the respondent No.2.
Though on several hearing dates, respondent No.2 appeared before this Court and participated in the proceedings, she did not make any allegations against the accused Nos.1 to 6.

All of a sudden after lapse of two years,
she has chosen to file complaint against the accused Nos.1 to 6 alleging offences punishable under Sections 143, 147, 307, 341, 323, 355, 498A, 420, 504, 506 r/w Section 149 Indian Penal Code with a view to harass them and prays to allow the petitions and quash the criminal proceedings against them.

9. On the other hand, learned High Court Government Pleader representing the respondent No.1- State and the learned counsel representing respondent No.2-complainant submits that the allegations made in the complaint are serious and in order to establish the allegations, a detailed investigation is necessary.
The allegations against accused Nos.1 to 6 are required to be established in a full fledged trial.
It is very nascent stage to examine the merits of the complaint averments and prays to dismiss the petitions.

sentences.text: Heard elaborate arguments of both sides and perused the records.
Respondent No.2 who is the complainant has filed a complaint dated 14.10.2021 alleging that she is a BE graduate and preparing for GATE exam.

Accused No.1-Amogh Ramachandra Wadeyar is also a BE graduate and they are neighbours and they developed friendship over social media and ultimately it turned into a love affair and physical relationship.
The complaint reveal that they had sexual intercourse on several occasions.
Though respondent No.2 has alleged that every time Shri. Amogh Wadeyar S/O Ramakrishna ... vs State Of Karnataka on 17 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125109212/
6 petitioner had sexual relationship with her, she resisted, admittedly, she has not filed any complaint against accused No.1 alleging that he had sexual intercourse against her will and consent.
On the other hand, she has alleged that though he promised to marry her, ultimately he started avoiding her.
Later on she came to know that he has started having relationship with another girl by name Kavita and he is having physical relationship with her also.
Ultimately she has chosen to file complaint alleging that after promising to marry her, he has gone against the promise and is refusing to marry her.
13. It appears that in the meanwhile accused No.1 was appointed as a Reserve Police Inspector and he was undergoing training.
At this stage, respondent No.2 has chosen to file the complaint.
After the filing of the complaint, both accused No.1 and respondent No.2 have married and they have also got their marriage registered before the Registrar of Marriage.

Accused No.1 has alleged that after the marriage though he left respondent No.2 in his house, she was not interested in continuing her married life and she started unnecessarily making allegations against his family members and ultimately within a period of one week she left their house.

In fact she gave a statement before the investigating officer that out of fear that petitioner may not marry her she chose to file a false complaint against him and now that they have married, she is not having any grievance against him.
However after giving such statement, once again she has chosen to file a second complaint making allegations also against the mother, brothers and relatives of accused No.1 alleging that while she stayed in their house, she was harassed, ill- treated, abused and also on more than one occasion,
they tried to kill her.
14. At the outset, it is relevant to note that both accused No.1 as well as respondent No.2-complainant are adults.
They are engineering graduates and it appears their houses are nearby.
They became friends through social media.
From the conduct of respondent No.2 it is evident that she is really insecure about her relationship with the petitioner.

It appears when the process of his appointment was going on, fearing that he will not marry her, she has chosen to file a complaint against the accused No.1 in Crime No.179/2021 alleging that promising to marry her he has developed physical relationship and now he is going back from his words.
However, even after the said complaint was filed, in the midst of undergoing training, accused No.1 has chosen to enter into marriage with respondent No.2.
He has also chosen to get it registered.

15. It appears after the registration of the marriage, respondent No.2 has chosen to give a statement before the investigating officer stating that fearing that he may not marry her, she chose to file the false complaint and after the marriage, she does not have any grievance.
However, it appears that she is not coming forward to file a compromise petition.
In the meanwhile after realizing that she is not having any more grounds to proceed against the accused No.1, she has chosen to file a fresh complaint against him and others.
Admittedly for a very short period, she stayed in the house of the accused No.1 along with his parents and others.
Though she has made allegations that they tried to kill her by giving sleeping pills and also poisonous tea, admittedly she has not taken any medical treatment for the same.
16. Respondent No.2 is not an illiterate.
She is a BE graduate and preparing for GATE exam.
She knows the consequences of the consent which she has given towards the physical relationship Shri.

sentences.text: After petitioner No.1 married her, she has no ground to proceed against him for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(n) Indian Penal Code and the remaining offences are consequential to the first offence.

After realizing that she is not having any ground to proceed in respective of the first complaint, she has chosen to deliberately file the second complaint, also including the family members of the petitioner No.1.
The allegations made in the complaint are such that even that if a prolonged trial is held, ultimately they may not result in the conviction of the petitioners.
The continuation of the criminal proceedings against the petitioners would amount to abuse of the process of the Court.
17. In the light of the facts and circumstances of the case, the decisions relied upon by the respondent No.2-complainant are not applicable to the case on hand.

18. Thus, from the above discussion I hold that the petitions deserves to be allowed and accordingly,
I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER Petitions filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. are allowed.

The impugned proceedings in Crime Nos.181/2022 of Harugeri police station for the offences punishable under Sections 143, 147, 307, 341, 323, 498A, 420, 504, 506 AND 149 of IPC and Crime No.179/2021 of Harugeri police station for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2) (n), 323, 420, 504, 506 of IPC, insofar as petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 6 are concerned, are hereby quashed.
